name: LL Bean Performance
description: Retail performance: KPIs, customer retention cohort, and performance detail.

elements.body: ## **L.L.Bean** · Retail Performance Outside Together Since 1912 — revenue, retention & profitability
### ━━ **Performance Detail** — trends, leaders & order mix

name.text: Revenue by Month — Year over Year

columns.formula: If([Order Value] < 1000, "1. Under $1K", If([Order Value] < 2000, "2. $1K-$2K", If([Order Value] < 3000, "3. $2K-$3K", If([Order Value] < 5000, "4. $3K-$5K", "5. $5K+"))))
columns.name: AOV Bucket

columns.formula: Rollup(Min([Retail Transactions Raw/Date]), [Cust Key], [Retail Transactions Raw/Cust Key])
columns.name: First Purchase Date

columns.formula: [Transactions with Details & Relationships (5M)/customer info/Cust Zip Code]
[Transactions with Details & Relationships (5M)/store info/Store Zip Code]
